examples.text: Он снял с головы котелок и застенчиво приглаживал ладонью белёсые волосы.

Ярко-рыжие волосы, белёсые ресницы, широкий нос и резко выступающий вперёд подбородок.

examples.text: Мёртво выдвигались из тумана пригородные кусты, белёсые от далёкого зарева.

examples.text: The skin was somewhat pigmented, especially in certain regions, while over the whole there appeared whitish, rounded or oval mottlings or dapplings, most obvious where the surrounding cuticle was most deeply colored.

examples.text: The lighting was too dim for me to make out his facial features.
that sustaining Love / Which, through the web of being blindly wove / By man and beast and earth and air and sea, / Burns bright or dim
He may be a bit dim, but he's not entirely stupid.
His vision grew dimmer as he aged.

glosses: Disapproving, unfavorable: rarely used outside the phrase take a dim view of.

examples.text: All about me the Red Weed clambered among the ruins, writhing to get above me in the dim. Night, the Mother of Fear and Mystery, was coming upon me.
He dimmed the lights and put on soft music.
The lights dimmed briefly when the air conditioning was turned on.

glosses: To render dim, obscure, or dark; to make less bright or distinct.

examples.text: a king among his courtiers,[…] who out to dim the lustre of all his attendants
Now ſet the ſun, and twilight dimm'd the ways, […]

glosses: To deprive of distinct vision; to hinder from seeing clearly, either by dazzling or clouding the eyes; to darken the senses or understanding of.

examples.text:
And with our Sun-bright armour as we march,
Weel chaſe the Starrs from heauen, and dim their eies
That ſtand and muſe at our admyred armes.
Her starry eyes were dimm'd with streaming tears.
All these setbacks had started to dim the hopes of the students.
Nothing will dim their spirit of resilience.
A glut might dim the outlook for grain futures.
